referenceFunction.includedProcesses: Electricity from wind farm, fed to grid. Includes the operation of the wind farm with the necessary change of gear oil. 200MW wind farm, consisting of 59 onshore IEA reference wind turbines of.3.4MW each (Bortolotti et al., 2019; Cooperman et al., 2023). Model is based on the capacity factor of 23.5%, representing the average capacity factor of onshore wind farms in Europe between 2016-2024 (source: ENTSO-E). Assumed lifetime is 25 years. Annual electricity production is413 GWh, applying a capacity factor of 23.5%.
